Getting Pre-Approved in Redondo Beach

Pre-approval is a working tool — not a badge. Here is the path I use before you tour from the Hollywood Riviera to North Redondo. For a deeper walkthrough, read how to get pre-approved for a mortgage — then we connect those steps to your specific Redondo Beach search.

  1. Discovery call. Timeline, target pockets in 90277 or 90278, first purchase or move-up.

  3. Credit & income. We review scores, debts, and how income is calculated; fix issues early.
  4. Program fit. Match price to product — e.g. FHA vs. conventional in 90278, or jumbo in 90277.
  5. Pre-approval letter. A limit grounded in real underwriting questions — plus my pre-approval guide so you know what the letter means.
